## Feature Registry status

The [Feature Registry](../../docs/technical/Feature%20Registry.md) is the
single authoritative list of everything Nexus builds — nothing ships that
isn't listed there first.

- [ ] This maps to an existing Feature Registry entry: **F-\_\_\_**
- [ ] This is **not yet** in the Feature Registry (fill out "New capability" below)

## New capability (only if not already in the Feature Registry)

If this doesn't map to an existing F-number, it needs to be proposed as an
addition to the Feature Registry before any implementation starts. Describe:

- Which group it belongs to (see the Feature Registry's groupings)
- A one-paragraph explanation written the way an F-number entry reads
- Which Engineering Roadmap phase it would fit into

## Affected area

- [ ] `apps/web` (public site)
- [ ] `apps/admin` (CMS)
- [ ] `packages/api` / `packages/contracts`
- [ ] Infra / deployment
- [ ] Docs only

## Locale considerations
